text:
sarah: Heads up — CS reports a cluster of 500/503 errors from hosted inference (us-east-1) starting ~2024-06-12 11:12 UTC. Multiple customer timeouts and a few billing duplicates. Anyone triaging?

 tomas: I'm on it. Seeing a spike in container restarts on infer-runner pods. nvml shows sudden GPU mem growth -> OOM then SIGSEGV.

 jordan: paste logs:
```
2024-06-12T11:12:34Z runner[pid=1245]: Allocation failed: CUDA_ERROR_OUT_OF_MEMORY
2024-06-12T11:12:35Z runner[pid=1245]: Received SIGSEGV (address=0x7fffc123)
2024-06-12T11:12:35Z system: container exitCode=139 restartCount=1
```

 luis: Customer repro looks like: mixed tool-calls + long context (> 50k tokens) + concurrent model-swap. Prefetch thread tries to populate KV cache and blows memory.

 maya: PagerDuty assigned -> ops-oncall. Mitigation proposals:
- temp rate-limit per key to 3 r/s
- disable prefetch for the hot model in us-east-1
- route heavy keys to dedicated capacity or cpu quantized variant

 ops-oncall: Acknowledged. Running `kubectl scale` to add 10 runners to pool, and set `PREFETCH_ENABLED=false` for deployment redwood-llama-70b.

 support-bot: Noted CS: created ticket INC-2024-1248 and alerted affected customers (Acme, NovaHealth).

 tomas: Quick check: disabling prefetch dropped OOM crashes by ~60% in the next 10m. Still seeing a few segfaults on swap. Captured core + coredump stack:
```
#0 0x7fbb12ab in ml_infer::attn::kv_prefetch()
#1 0x7fbb4001 in ml_infer::model::forward()
#2 0x7faad123 in runtime::run_loop()
```

 jordan: Uploaded artifacts: s3://redwood-artifacts/incidents/1769999991/core-and-nvml.tgz

 tomas: Temporary rollback to runtime v0.9.11 pushed by deploy-bot.

 deploy-bot: Rollback complete. Verified 5xx rate down to normal for affected traffic.

 sarah: Thanks. Assigning to eng-runtime and eng-ml for postmortem + root cause. Next steps: reproduce locally with model-swap + prefetch stress test, add guardrails for KV allocs, and add fallback routing when OOM risk detected.

 jordan: Notes for repro:
```
# stress script
for i in {1..200}; do
  curl -s -X POST https://api.redwood.com/v1/generate \
    -H "Authorization: Bearer $KEY" \
    -d '{"model":"redwood/llama-70b","input":"<very long context>","max_tokens":4096}' &
 done
```

 sarah: I'll update CS and leave this thread open. Ping if anything changes. :white_check_mark:
